paragraphs: A stunning blend of modern design and celestial inspiration. Drawing from the beauty of the cosmos, the ASTRO features a sleek, elliptical glass shade that evokes the shape of an orbiting planet. The glass, delicately frosted, diffuses light gently, creating a soft glow reminiscent of starlight.

The elliptical shade is cradled by a sophisticated looped metal fixture, symbolising the infinite paths of celestial bodies. The intricate metalwork, enhances the fixture’s elegance. Versatile in design, the ASTRO can be mounted as a wall sconce or ceiling light.

Whether illuminating a hallway or adding ambiance to a living space, the ASTRO brings the mystery and wonder of the cosmos into any room. Customisable in various metal finishes, timber and stains, and lengths upon enquiry. paragraphs: The surface mounted light, features a hand-blown glass shade, elegantly shaped to enhance its surroundings with a refined, organic form. The various glass options, exhibit one of our signature textures, allowing light to diffuse softly, creating a warm and inviting ambience.

Its unique, artisan-crafted nature brings a sense of individuality to each piece, as no two are identical. Complementing the glass is custom-designed brass fixings that highlight both strength and sophistication. The brass elements, add a touch of luxury while ensuring durability.

These fixings seamlessly blend functionality with aesthetic appeal, allowing for secure mounting while enhancing the overall design. This fixture is ideal for a variety of settings, providing both a practical source of illumination and a striking visual statement.

Its harmonious combination of materials makes it a versatile addition to modern or traditional interiors, elevating the space with its timeless elegance. products.name: XYZ
products.meta_description: Our Limited Edition XYZ Wall Light features a composition of three volumes aligned to the XYZ axis. A cuboid fixture on the X-axes, a cylindrical stem on t
paragraphs: Our Limited Edition XYZ Wall Light features a composition of three volumes aligned to the XYZ axis. A cuboid fixture on the X-axes, a cylindrical stem on the Y-axes, and a handblown glass sphere protrudes on the Z-axes. Inspired by De Stijl (meaning, the style), a casual organisation of Dutch painters, architects and sculptors, is one of the more influential of the avant-garde modern art movements.

The movement's aim was to promulgate a new design paradigm of harmony and order, by reducing all art to essentials of form and colour. De Stijl's leading members Piet Mondrian (1872-1944) and the architect Gerrit Rietveld (1888-1964), greatly impacted the architectural design of Le Corbusier (1887-1965) and Mies van der Rohe (1883-1969).

products.meta_description: Illuminate your space with ILANEL's Comet Pendant, featuring radiating rods that burst with energy and style. An impactful presence perfect for modern interiors.

Adding an extra touch of artistry, each pendant is graced with an array of exquisite hand-blown glass beads, presenting a range of distinctive design choices. Personalisation takes centre stage with Comet, which is available with harmonising metal ends that resonate with its sleek aesthetic or the enchanting alternative of feature timber ends, offering a fusion of organic warmth and contemporary elegance.

Customisable in various metal finishes, timber and stains, and lengths upon enquiry. paragraphs: The concept behind Rain is illuminating: a multi-sensory experience of sight and sound that invites touch and interaction. Rain captures the shimmery sparkle of raindrops frozen in descent and voices a whimsy chime of flutes. Individual drops are visually quite subtle but gain tremendous strength when multiplied and clustered in their modular design.

Rain is a modular chandelier. However, it can be suspended as a single pendant light. Available in customisable configurations and finishes upon enquiry.
